name: Dyson Hair Stylers: Demos and Tutorials
what_it_is: Creators demonstrate and review Dyson hot-air styling tools (Airwrap, Airstrait, straighteners), showing wet-to-dry styling, curling, straightening and before/after results, with some comparing cheaper alternatives like Cecotec or complaining about the attachments. Videos range from sponsored mall-stand promos to at-home get-ready-with-me routines.
